scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run theme:dev" "npm run vite:dev" "npm run scss:dev"
scripts.build: npm run scss:build && npm run vite:build && npm run clean
scripts.scss:dev: sass --embed-source-map src/scss/global/:assets src/scss/components/:assets src/scss/sections/:assets src/scss/libs/:assets src/scss/blocks/:assets --watch
scripts.push: npm run build && shopify theme push --allow-live
scripts.zip: npm run build && shopify theme package
